intro: Thadius Grimshade tells you where Sharpbeak is kept: in a cage on a high cliff, atop Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands. Vile Priestess Hexx, high priestess of the Vilebranch trolls, has the key. You are to carry the news to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Sharpbeak is held in a cage, high on a cliff at the top of Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands. The key to this cage is possessed by the high priestess of the Vilebranch trolls, Vile Priestess Hexx.
There. I have done my part. I bid you fortune on your quest, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've spoken with Grimshade? What did he say?
...What? The Vilebranch trolls have Sharpbeak? That's unbearable! We must organize a force to get him back!
